import click
from click.shell_completion import FishComplete, CompletionItem

cli = click.Command('cli', params=[
    click.Option(['--at', '--attachment-type'], help='\b\nAttachment with explicit mimetype,\n--at image.jpg image/jpeg'),
])

comp = FishComplete(cli, {}, 'cli', '_CLI_COMPLETE')

# Manually test format_completion
item = CompletionItem('--at', help='\b\nAttachment with explicit mimetype,\n--at image.jpg image/jpeg')
formatted = comp.format_completion(item)
print('Formatted output:')
print(repr(formatted))
print()
print('Lines in formatted output:')
for i, line in enumerate(formatted.split('\n')):
    print(f'  Line {i}: {repr(line)}')
"
